name: dispatch_counter_threshold_tiers
description: Compares a score-like counter against three rising thresholds (255, 65535 and 16777215) and calls the same routine for each tier reached, gated by a global state check. The routine has no other work.

name: render_nibble_pair_rows
description: Splits a byte into high and low nibbles, mapping a zero nibble to ten, and writes eight rows of table-indexed values into two buffers forty bytes apart, duplicating each value into the adjacent byte. A flag decides whether the second nibble is written.

name: dispatch_copper_and_vblank_interrupts
description: Ands the interrupt enable and request registers and calls one handler when the copper bit is set and another when the vertical blank bit is set. It returns its input registers unchanged.

name: acknowledge_vblank_interrupt
description: Writes the vertical blank bit to the interrupt request register to clear that pending interrupt. It touches no other state.

name: run_frame_tick_on_flag
description: When a pending flag is set, clears it and advances an animation counter and a scroll value, calls drawing and game logic routines, and counts down a timer that spawns a new table entry when it expires. It then clears the flag, sets a global and acknowledges the interrupt.

name: handle_keyboard_serial_byte
description: When a pending bit is set, reads one keyboard serial byte from the CIA-A data register, stores its state as zero or all-ones in a table, and waits for the handshake bit before resetting. The decoding uses the key code bits and two routine calls.

name: acknowledge_keyboard_handshake
description: Clears a key-state table entry, waits until the CIA interrupt flag is set, then clears that flag and resets the handshake state. Its job is to complete the keyboard handshake after a byte is read.

name: update_object_table_by_type
description: Walks a table of object entries until an end marker, dispatching on each entry's type code with special cases for a few types, advances horizontal positions with masks, and reloads spawn timers when an entry is consumed. Several routines are called for drawing and collisions.

name: add_packed_decimal_score
description: Adds packed decimal digits into a multi-byte score one byte at a time, applying decimal adjustment after each step and carrying between bytes. It sets a flag when the high nibble changes after an addition.

name: claim_free_slot_for_entry
description: When a slot index is valid, a fixed sprite-style check passes and a position falls inside a window, it stores a position word in a table entry, adjusts it by fixed offsets, writes a second value and a parallel field, and clears the slot index to mark it used.

name: update_and_draw_entries
description: Walks a fixed set of entries, decrements each timer and frees expired ones, then for live entries in view ORs shifted masks into two plane buffers and raises a hit flag when a position falls in a range.

name: spawn_projectile_entry
description: When a slot index is set and a horizontal offset is inside a window, fills a projectile entry with a position plus a fixed offset, zeroes two fields, sets a vertical velocity from a scaled difference, and sets two timing values, with different timing for one type.

name: advance_and_draw_projectiles
description: Walks the projectile list, advances each position, frees entries that leave the view, raises a hit flag on a range match, and ORs pixel masks into one of two plane buffers chosen by a global.

name: toggle_double_buffer_pointers
description: Flips a one-bit buffer flag and reloads the active and back bitplane pointers, storing the outgoing pointers into backup slots, then calls a routine.

name: start_full_screen_blit
description: Waits for the blitter to be idle, programs the first and last word masks, modulo, source and destination pointers, and a fixed block size, then starts the blit.

name: run_six_setup_steps
description: Calls six routine routines in sequence, one of which points the copper at its list, with no logic of its own.

name: store_default_palette_entries
description: Writes fixed constant word pairs into two groups of globals that look like palette and tile palette entries, then returns.

name: install_interrupt_handler
description: Stores a handler address in an interrupt vector global, then writes an enable mask to the interrupt enable register to turn on the copper, vertical blank and ports interrupts.

name: configure_cia_serial_interrupt
description: Stores a handler address, enables the CIA-A serial interrupt, sets a timer count, clears the serial output mode bit, then masks a byte in a global.

name: call_two_routines_in_order
description: Calls two routine routines in sequence and does nothing else.

name: save_system_display_state
description: Calls a routine, then stores a graphics structure pointer, two copies of a global state word, and the interrupt enable register value into globals for later restoration.

name: disable_all_dma_and_interrupts
description: Writes the all-clear mask to the DMA control and interrupt enable registers, turning off every DMA channel and interrupt source.

name: restore_system_state_and_close
description: Restores the saved DMA, interrupt and copper pointer values, waits until a flag bit in the CIA port register reads set, then closes a library.

name: poll_until_nonzero_result
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer held in a global until it returns a nonzero value, then stores that value in a global.

name: poll_alternate_result_until_nonzero
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer held in a global until it returns a nonzero value, storing that result in a second global.

name: call_stored_routine_pointer
description: Calls a routine through a function pointer held in a global, once, and returns.

name: allocate_linked_command_record
description: Allocates a record through a library call, stores two arguments into it and links it into a list, then reads two library values. If the allocation fails it calls a cleanup routine and returns an error code.

name: replace_task_record_and_release
description: Stores a new record pointer in a per-task slot and releases the old record, calling a cleanup routine for each of the old record's fields that is set, then returns the new pointer.

name: setup_command_context_from_args
description: Allocates a context block, checks the first argument for a question-mark usage request, fills the context with pointers from library calls, then either runs the main action or reports usage.

name: apply_field_to_four_slots
description: Loops over four global slots and calls one routine for each, passing a field from the input structure and that slot's value.

name: scan_buffer_for_control_bytes
description: Calls a routine twice to prepare an eighty-byte buffer, then scans it and returns one if a byte falls in a range that looks like control codes, otherwise zero.

name: dispatch_pager_key_command
description: Waits for an input character while watching for a break signal, maps some key codes to zero, and dispatches the remaining codes to pager command handlers, returning a status value.

name: finish_and_exit_program
description: Calls a cleanup routine and another routine, then invokes an exit routine supplied through a register.

name: run_viewer_page_loop
description: Sets up a viewer state structure with routine calls, then repeatedly calls a page routine while the current position is before the end of the buffer and no stop flag is set.

name: advance_viewer_line_count
description: Reads a buffer through two routine calls, stores the second result in the viewer state, and increments the current line counter when a link field is clear.

name: read_next_text_line
description: Reads up to 128 bytes into a buffer, scans for a newline or form-feed character to find the line length, seeks past the terminator, and sets a flag when a form feed was found.

name: display_page_lines_until_quit
description: Chooses how many lines to show from a flag and a screen-size field, then loops displaying lines and reading keys until the key read is the q character.

name: search_text_forward_loop
description: Repeatedly advances through the text and tests each step with a routine until a match is reported, returning one when found and zero when the count runs out.

name: call_with_setup_and_teardown
description: Calls setup and teardown routines around a main call whose arguments come from a parameter block and a global, optionally calls an extra routine when a flag is set, and returns the main call's result.

name: call_routine_with_optional_followup
description: Calls a routine with two arguments, then calls a second routine with the first argument only when a state flag is clear.

name: refresh_status_line_at_position
description: Calls a drawing routine with a state field and a fixed negative value, then calls a second routine with the current line index from the viewer state.

name: redraw_last_visible_line
description: Calls a drawing routine with a fixed value, then calls a second routine with the viewer's last line index minus one.

name: print_text_lines_to_limit
description: Walks a text buffer up to a limit of 128 characters, counting lines and calling output routines for each segment, and stops at a terminating character or when the line count is reached.

name: call_display_routine_with_buffer
description: Calls a routine with one argument, then calls a second routine with a buffer pointer from the state structure and a global.

name: reset_line_index_if_clear
description: When a mode field in the parameter block is zero, resets the viewer's current line index to one, then calls a routine with a buffer pointer.

name: call_routine_with_line_pointer
description: Calls a routine with a buffer pointer and a second argument that is the viewer's current line index plus one when a flag is set, otherwise a global address.

name: pass_line_or_globals_to_routine
description: Calls a routine with a global address repeated three times when a flag is clear, or with the viewer's current line index when the flag is set.

name: clamp_second_result_to_zero
description: Calls a routine twice with the same first argument and different seek-style third arguments, then returns the second result clamped to zero when negative.

name: copy_from_read_buffer
description: Copies a requested number of bytes from a read buffer into the destination, refilling the buffer through a routine when it runs short, then advances the buffer offset and position fields and reduces the remaining count.

name: refill_read_buffer_block
description: Moves any unread bytes to the front of the read buffer and reads a fixed block of 4096 bytes through a library call, updating the buffer size and position fields.

name: scroll_window_to_target_line
description: Computes a target position from a mode argument, either the window start or the last line, and adjusts the window position while checking it against the buffer bounds.

name: read_line_into_buffer
description: Reads bytes one at a time with a routine into a buffer until a newline or a limit of about 127 bytes, terminates the string with a zero byte and returns the count read.

name: copy_null_terminated_string
description: Copies bytes from a source string into a destination, including the terminating zero byte.

name: uppercase_string_in_place
description: Converts each lowercase ASCII letter in a null-terminated string to uppercase, in place.

name: parse_signed_decimal_string
description: Parses an optional plus or minus sign followed by decimal digits from a null-terminated string and returns the signed integer value.

name: signal_bound_task_if_present
description: Calls a library function with a bound task pointer and a full signal mask when the structure holds a non-null task pointer and the argument is non-null.

name: output_text_entry_with_newline
description: Outputs the linked parts of a structure recursively, then the text argument or a stored string, and when a flag is set reads from the output until a newline character is returned.

name: send_one_word_request
description: Stores one argument in a stack buffer and passes it with a fixed request code and a length of one to a library call, returning that call's result.

name: request_block_and_copy_fields
description: Allocates a 36-byte block, sends its size in longwords with a fixed request code, copies two fields from the block into the output structure and frees the block.

name: allocate_linked_record_from_source
description: Allocates a 68-byte record, links its self pointers and its template and source fields, then copies a count of words from the source address into the record.

name: forward_call_with_stack_slot
description: Calls a routine with its two parameters plus the address of a stack argument slot.

name: read_single_character
description: Calls a routine to read into a four-byte stack buffer, returning the character when exactly one byte was read and minus one otherwise.

name: print_stack_buffer_string
description: Calls a library function, then measures the null-terminated text in a 140-byte stack buffer and passes the text and its length to a routine when it is not empty.

name: divide_unsigned_longword
description: Performs unsigned 32-bit division by shift and subtract, returning the quotient and remainder, with a separate path when the divisor fits in 16 bits.

name: multiply_longwords_partial_products
description: Multiplies two 32-bit values using 16-bit partial products and returns the low 32 bits of the product.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decoded from data rather than real code: the routine calls itself without any condition and is not a working routine.

name: negate_result_when_flag_set
description: Calls a routine and returns its first result, negated when the routine's second result is nonzero.

name: invoke_stored_library_vector
description: Calls a library function whose address is read from a fixed offset in a global base pointer, with no arguments.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the input register to the memory address held in the address register.

name: allocate_and_fill_message_block
description: Allocates a 34-byte message block, fills in a pointer argument, a parameter byte and a type code, sends it through a library call and returns the result, freeing the block on failure.

name: release_message_port
description: Removes the entry from its list when it is linked, marks its status and identifier fields as deleted, releases its signal bit and frees the 34-byte block.

name: search_text_for_pattern
description: Searches the first text for the second string, giving up at a newline; returns one when the pattern is found and zero otherwise.

name: initialize_list_header
description: Sets up an empty list header in a structure by pointing its first word to itself, clearing the next word and setting the tail pointer to the header itself.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_and_call
description: If a destination pointer is given, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset of a base into it, then calls a stored handler.

name: launch_command_process
description: Builds a launch record and tag list on the stack, copies sixteen longwords of setup data into it, stores a handler pointer, and calls library routines to create and start the process.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_and_call
description: If a destination pointer is given, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset of a base into it, then calls a stored handler.

name: launch_command_process
description: Builds a launch record and tag list on the stack, copies sixteen longwords of setup data into it, stores a handler pointer, and calls library routines to create and start the process.

name: copy_sixteen_longwords_and_call
description: If a destination pointer is given, copies sixteen longwords from a fixed offset of a base into it, then calls a stored handler.

name: run_command_line_as_process
description: Allocates a context record, then either takes the current shell buffer or the command line, splits it into arguments at spaces and tabs, and calls library routines to run the command.

name: store_argument_in_task_slot
description: Retrieves a pointer from a global structure, stores the argument in a slot of the structure it points to, and calls cleanup routines for previously stored values that are set before returning the new slot value.

name: run_loadwb_setup_with_buffer
description: Checks a library lookup, allocates a 162-byte buffer, passes a global string through a pair of XOR loops, calls several library functions and handles the result before returning.

name: compare_strings_ordered
description: Compares two null-terminated strings byte by byte and returns minus one, one or zero for less, greater or equal.

name: build_node_list_from_table
description: For each entry of a pointer table, allocates a small node, copies a value from the table into it and links the nodes into a new list, returning the head node.

name: forbid_multitasking
description: Calls the exec library's Forbid function through its base to disable task switching.

name: permit_multitasking
description: Calls the exec library's Permit function through its base to re-enable task switching.

name: allocate_memory_through_exec
description: Calls the exec library's AllocMem function through its base, passing the caller's arguments.

name: find_current_task
description: Calls the exec library's FindTask function through its base and returns the task it finds.

name: send_message_to_port
description: Calls the exec library's PutMsg function through its base to put a message on a port.

name: receive_message_from_port
description: Calls the exec library's GetMsg function through its base to take a message from a port.

name: wait_for_port_message
description: Calls the exec library's WaitPort function through its base to block until a port has a message.

name: close_library_handle
description: Calls the exec library's CloseLibrary function through its base to release an opened library.

name: open_library_by_name
description: Calls the exec library's OpenLibrary function through its base to open a library by name.

name: invoke_library_vector_624
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset from the base held in a global variable, with no arguments, and returns.

name: pad_matching_name_buffer
description: Compares a global string with a fixed-position buffer and, if the global string matches its start, writes a dot and four spaces into the buffer at a fixed offset.

name: write_dot_and_spaces_suffix
description: Writes a dot followed by four spaces into a buffer at a fixed offset.

name: match_global_prefix
description: Compares a global string with the start of a buffer, stopping at the end of the global string or the first mismatch.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns; it is an empty stub with no observable operation.

name: write_to_dos_file
description: Calls the DOS library's Write function through its base, with arguments the caller has already placed.

name: get_dos_output_handle
description: Calls the DOS library's Output function through its base to obtain the standard output handle.

name: invoke_library_vector_198
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset from the base held in a global variable, with no arguments, and returns.

name: forward_call_with_stack_slot
description: Calls a routine with its two parameters plus the address of a stack argument slot.

name: print_stack_buffer_string
description: Calls a library function, then measures the null-terminated text in a 140-byte stack buffer and passes the text and its length to a routine when it is not empty.

name: store_byte_through_pointer
description: Writes the low byte of the input register to the memory address held in the address register.

name: jump_to_unrecovered_target
description: Calls a library function from a fixed offset of a global base, then jumps through a jump table whose targets were not recovered, so the real behaviour cannot be determined from this code.

name: set_background_color_entry
description: Writes to the background colour register and calls four routines. The decompiler timed out, so the rest of this entry's logic cannot be recovered from the evidence.

name: store_low_byte_and_halve
description: Stores the low byte of a value read from memory into a destination word, then returns the value shifted right by one with its top bit set.

name: shift_bits_from_stream
description: Shifts a bit buffer right one bit per iteration for a count, refilling the buffer through a routine whenever it becomes zero.

name: find_device_entry_by_name
description: Looks up a device entry in a linked list by comparing a name string, then copies the matched entry's name and up to sixteen longword fields into shared storage.

name: copy_device_entry_fields
description: Copies a name string from a record into a shared buffer, then copies up to sixteen longwords from the record's list into a second buffer.

name: allocate_ramdisk_buffers
description: Copies a block of longwords, computes the disk size from block bounds, allocates a memory buffer for it and stores pointers to it, clearing them when allocation fails.

name: initialize_device_unit_and_link
description: Fills in the unit's internal pointers, links the unit at the head of a device list while interrupts are disabled, calls a library function and re-enables interrupts when the nesting counter drops.

name: repeat_library_vector_call_twice
description: Calls a library function at a fixed offset from a base register twice, then returns zero.

name: disable_interrupts_and_find_entry
description: Writes the interrupt-enable clear mask, increments a nesting counter and walks a linked list until it reaches an entry that meets its condition.

name: release_interrupt_nesting
description: Decrements a nesting counter and re-enables interrupts with the enable mask when it reaches zero; a routine is called first when a flag is set.

name: decrement_interrupt_nesting
description: Decrements a nesting counter and, when it drops below one, writes the enable mask to the interrupt register to re-enable interrupts.

name: store_value_in_device_field
description: Stores its argument into a fixed field of the structure in the address register and returns zero.

name: dispatch_request_through_table
description: Disables multitasking, reads a request code from the message, calls the handler selected from a sixteen-entry table, stores its result in the message and then calls a library routine to finish.

name: return_error_code_minus_three
description: Returns the constant minus three as an error result.

name: process_request_queue_entry
description: Increments an activity counter, decrements a countdown field in the request and, when it goes negative with a link present, processes the request through routine calls.

name: unlink_device_unit
description: Copies a field to the output pointer, removes the given unit from a singly linked list of units, then calls a library function.

name: append_colon_to_name_string
description: Calls a library function, finds the end of a null-terminated name, writes a colon over its terminator and then calls another library function.

name: stub_unimplemented_halt
description: Only calls a halt for unimplemented code, so it is a stub with no working behaviour.

name: store_argument_in_global
description: Stores its register input into a global variable and returns.

name: remove_node_and_release_block
description: If the node's pending flag is clear, unlinks it from its list and calls a library release function, returning that result; otherwise marks the node pending and returns zero.

name: mark_node_pending_removal
description: Sets a pending-removal bit in a node's flag byte and returns zero.

name: acquire_node_use
description: Increments a node's use count unless it is pending removal, initialises its values on first use, and returns the node; returns minus one when it is pending removal.

name: return_minus_one_error
description: Returns minus one as a fixed failure result.

name: release_node_use
description: Decrements a node's use count, removing it through a routine when the count reaches zero and the pending-removal flag is set, and returns that result or zero.

name: forward_to_math_routine
description: Calls one math routine through a library vector and returns.

name: process_single_float_mantissa_loop
description: Returns early for zero and forwards negative inputs to a routine; otherwise it runs a loop of twenty-three steps over a mantissa-sized value, the width of a single-precision fraction.

name: divide_by_restoring_bit_loop
description: Repeatedly sets one result bit selected by a count and subtracts it from a shifted remainder, a restoring division loop that runs for the count's width.

name: adjust_status_word_flags
description: Calls a library routine and adjusts its status word by clearing one flag bit and setting another, then returns the result.

name: run_math_routine_sequence
description: Calls a fixed sequence of nine library routines from one base, alternating between two table entries and finishing with a third.

name: check_operand_flags_and_dispatch
description: Calls two library routines that set comparison flags and, when both flags match the expected pattern, calls a further routine and returns its result.

name: check_second_flags_and_dispatch
description: Calls two library routines that set comparison flags and, when both flags match the expected pattern, calls a further routine and returns its result, using the second flag variable.

name: finish_math_operation_with_flags
description: Calls a library routine to test flags, conditionally calls two more routines, then checks an operand value before returning a result.

name: dispatch_by_sign_and_zero
description: Chooses between library routine sequences based on whether an operand is zero and on its sign, then returns the routine result.

name: dispatch_by_sign_then_finish
description: Chooses a library routine sequence from the sign and zero state of an operand, calls the chosen sequence, then calls a finishing routine and returns its result.

name: finish_math_result_clear_flags
description: Calls a library routine, then returns its result with two status bits cleared.

name: finish_math_result_twice
description: Calls the same library routine twice, then returns its result with two status bits cleared.

name: finish_math_result_twice
description: Calls the same library routine twice, then returns its result with two status bits cleared.

name: close_library_from_base
description: Calls the exec library's CloseLibrary function through the library base stored in a global.

name: open_library_from_base
description: Calls the exec library's OpenLibrary function through the library base stored in a global.

name: clamp_operand_exponent_range
description: Clears the sign bit of an operand and, when its exponent-like byte is above a bound, sets a flag and calls a routine.

name: shift_subtract_quotient_loop
description: Shifts an operand by a masked count and subtracts shifted values in a loop limited to twenty-four steps, building a quotient.

name: accumulate_shifted_partial_sums
description: Repeatedly adds a shifted value to an accumulator and subtracts shifted partial values, calling routines when a counter reaches its limit.

name: classify_byte_operand_range
description: Tests a byte operand against doubled-value bounds, returns early outside the top range, otherwise calls three routines and masks the low byte of the operand.

name: classify_signed_byte_band
description: Returns early for a signed byte outside a band, otherwise tests its doubled value against bounds and calls routines.

name: classify_negative_byte_bound
description: Tests a signed byte against doubled-value bounds, returns early outside the range and otherwise calls routines for the band.

name: classify_unsigned_byte_bound
description: Returns early for an unsigned byte below a bound, otherwise tests its doubled value against an upper limit and calls routines.

name: classify_signed_byte_with_calls
description: Returns early for a byte outside the sign-dependent band, otherwise tests its doubled value and calls routines for the matching range.

name: normalize_byte_operand_flags
description: Calls three routines, then masks the operand's low byte and sets its sign flag from the result of a routine call.

name: compute_scaled_remainder_loop
description: Adjusts a sum by a shifted divisor in a loop controlled by a signed count, then returns the adjusted value.

name: select_fixed_constant_by_sign
description: Selects one of two large fixed-point constants according to the sign of its operand, adds a scaled operand and runs a shift loop over the result.

name: accumulate_fixed_point_terms
description: Loops over a table of terms, accumulating scaled sums into three accumulators and calling routines for each step.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns; it is an empty stub with no observable operation.

name: stub_bad_instruction_data
description: Decoded from data rather than real code: it makes a self-call to its own entry point with no condition, so it is not a working routine.

name: chain_two_routine_calls
description: Calls two routines in sequence without any logic of its own.

name: convert_integer_to_float_format
description: Converts a signed integer to the packed float form by normalising its magnitude through shifts and selecting an exponent code from its sign.

name: normalize_mantissa_by_doubling
description: Returns early when its exponent-like byte is at its limit, otherwise normalises the mantissa by repeated doubling and records the result.

name: call_routine_then_repeat
description: Calls a routine, then calls it again twice when a flag remains clear.

name: call_routine_then_three_followups
description: Calls a routine, then calls three further routines in sequence when a flag remains clear.

name: call_routines_with_incremented_count
description: When its input is nonzero and no overflow occurs, calls two routines with the count incremented by one and then a third routine.

description: Does nothing and returns; it is an empty stub with no observable operation.

description: Does nothing and returns; it is an empty stub with no observable operation.

name: pack_float_with_shift
description: Returns for zero input, otherwise computes a shift from the low exponent byte, shifts the mantissa and stores a packed word in the result, calling routines along the way.

name: run_four_routine_sequence
description: Calls four routines in sequence without any logic of its own.

name: sum_alternating_table_entries
description: Walks a table, adding each entry while the accumulator is negative and subtracting it otherwise, until the count runs out.

name: accumulate_table_with_subtraction
description: Walks a table, adding and subtracting entries according to the sign of a running accumulator, and returns when the table is exhausted.

name: dispatch_operand_sign_routines
description: Tests a byte operand for zero and sign, calls routines accordingly, then returns.

name: stub_empty_return
description: Does nothing and returns; it is an empty stub with no observable operation.

name: pack_operand_after_routines
description: Calls four routines, then when a flag is set shifts a mantissa-sized value over a loop to pack the result.

name: divide_remainder_by_shift_loop
description: Computes a remainder and quotient bits by repeatedly subtracting a shifted divisor in a loop controlled by a count.

name: call_routine_three_times
description: Calls the same routine three times in succession, then returns.

name: classify_operand_sign_and_range
description: Calls routines depending on the sign of a byte operand and, for a nonzero value in range, calls further routines and sets a flag.

name: normalize_operand_after_calls
description: Calls two routines, returns if the operand is zero, otherwise calls a routine and computes a shift from the exponent byte to normalise the operand.

description: Does nothing and returns; it is an empty stub with no observable operation.

name: call_pointer_and_return_input
